title: Lake Tahoe, California Travel Guide
overview: Lake Tahoe combines major attractions with regional outdoor access and historical sites.

thingsToDo.title: Explore Lake Tahoe
thingsToDo.description: Lake Tahoe is a large freshwater lake in the Sierra Nevada on the California–Nevada border, with a surface elevation of about 6,225 feet and a maximum depth of roughly 1,645 feet. Those measurements make it the largest alpine lake in North America and the second-deepest lake in the United States. The basin was formed through geologic faulting and glaciation, and modern shoreline development spans multiple counties in two states. Because water clarity and watershed management have been monitored for decades by regional agencies, the lake is also a prominent environmental policy case in western public land planning. Its bi-state jurisdiction and physical scale define the destination more than any single resort or town center.
